original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹军方在朱巴枪击案调查中为基尔姻亲洗清嫌疑
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹军方称，调查委员会未发现证据表明国防与退伍军人事务部副部长、总统萨尔瓦·基尔的姻亲格雷戈里·登·库阿克中将与9月朱巴机场附近一起土地纠纷引发的枪击事件有关。军方发言人称该纠纷属私人当事方之间，并指控部分反对派支持者利用此事损害格雷戈里声誉，但这些指控未获独立核实。发言人还通报了利尔县、阿科博县冲突及选举安保安排。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹军方称调查未发现格雷戈里·登·库阿克与9月朱巴机场附近枪击事件有关的证据
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: an investigation committee found no evidence linking Gregory Deng Kuac to the dispute or the shooting on Sept. 4 and 5

key_facts.fact: 社交媒体用户称该事件与涉及格雷戈里·登·库阿克的土地掠夺有关
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Social media users subsequently said that the incident was connected to land grabbing involving Gregory Deng Kuac

key_facts.fact: 军方发言人指控部分反对派支持者利用该事件损害格雷戈里声誉，相关指控未获独立核实
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: It also alleged that some opposition supporters and individuals with personal grievances had used the incident to damage Gregory’s reputation for political purposes. Those allegations were presented by the army spokesman as findings of the military investigation and were not independently verified.

key_facts.fact: 军方发言人称10月13日至14日利尔县冲突发生在苏丹人民解放军反对派（SPLA-IO）敌对派系之间，造成8人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: clashes on Oct. 13 and 14 in Leer County, Unity State, involved rival factions of the Sudan People’s Liberation Army in Opposition (SPLA-IO), rather than government forces. He said eight people were killed

key_facts.fact: 军方发言人称10月13日琼格莱州阿科博县Wecjal族群冲突造成6人死亡、17人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: communal clashes in Wecjal, Akobo County, Jonglei State, on Oct. 13 left six people dead and 17 wounded

uncertainties: 军方调查结论及对反对派支持者的指控未获独立核实
